Introduction

REST API for the MoboEats platform: customers (orderers), restaurants and grocery shops, riders and administrators.

Base URL: http://moboeats.test 
This is version 3 of the MoboEats API, served under `/api/v3`.

**Conventions**
- Successful responses return the resource itself (e.g. a `Restaurant` object, or an array of them).
  Paginated lists return `{"data": [...], "meta": {"current_page", "per_page", "total", "last_page"}}`.
- Errors return `{"message": "..."}` with a meaningful HTTP status code. Validation errors use `422` and add
  `"errors": {"field": ["message"]}`. `401` means not authenticated, `403` means not allowed.
- Shared object shapes are described under **Schemas** (`components.schemas`) of the OpenAPI spec.

The previous API (`/api/v1`, `/api/v2`) is deprecated and documented separately at `/docs-legacy`.

Authenticating requests

To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with the value "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

Authenticated endpoints use Laravel Sanctum bearer tokens. Obtain a token from the login endpoints (e.g. POST /api/v3/login) and send it as Authorization: Bearer {token}.

Admin

Dashboard

Get dashboard statistics

requires authentication

Return headline counts (customers, restaurants, riders, orders), order and payment time series, top restaurants, top menu items, platform settings, supplement counts and per-region earnings. Side effect: default settings (Delivery Rate, Base Service Charge Rate, Base Groceries Service Charge Rate, Registration Fee) are created if missing.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/dashboard?orders_timeline=past_six_months&payments_timeline=past_three_months" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/dashboard"
);

const params = {
    "orders_timeline": "past_six_months",
    "payments_timeline": "past_three_months",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

GET api/v3/admin/dashboard

Headers

Authorization        

Example: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}

Content-Type        

Example: application/json

Accept        

Example: application/json

Query Parameters

orders_timeline   string  optional    

Time range for the orders series. One of past_ten_years, past_five_years, past_three_years, past_six_months, past_three_months; any other value (or none) gives the past 12 months. Example: past_six_months

payments_timeline   string  optional    

Time range for the payments series. Same values as orders_timeline. Example: past_three_months

Response

Response Fields

Number of restaurants.

Number of riders.

Number of active/completed orders.

orders_series   object     

Chart series for orders (labels, data, direction, difference, total).

payments_series   object     

Chart series for payment amounts.

top_restaurants   object[]     

Top 5 restaurants by order count.

top_menu_series   object     

Top 5 menu item names and their percentage share.

settings   object[]     

All platform settings.

region_data   object     

Earnings breakdown keyed by country name.

    --header "Accept: application/json"

    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/categories"

const params = {
    "page": "1",

Object.keys(params)

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,

const params = {

Sub categories.

Create a grocery sub category

requires authentication

Create a sub category under the groceries common category and link it to that category. The image is stored on the category disk.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/sub-categories/add" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "title=Fresh Produce"\
    --form "status=2"\
    --form "description=Fruits and vegetables"\
    --form "image=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php923C.tmp" 
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/sub-categories/add"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('title', 'Fresh Produce');
body.append('status', '2');

    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "file=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php93FD.tmp" 
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/payouts/upload"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('file', document.querySelector('input[name="file"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());

Approve or deny a restaurant

requires authentication

Set a restaurant's status to approved (2) or denied (3). A reason is required when denying. The restaurant is notified of the status change.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/restaurants/8a7b6c5d-4e3f-2a1b-0c9d-8e7f6a5b4c3d/status/update" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"status\": 2,
    \"reason\": \"Missing food hygiene certificate\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/restaurants/8a7b6c5d-4e3f-2a1b-0c9d-8e7f6a5b4c3d/status/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "status": 2,
    "reason": "Missing food hygiene certificate"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Update a restaurant's service charge agreement

requires authentication

Set the restaurant's service charge percentage. When groceries is present in the request the groceries service charge agreement is updated instead.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/restaurant/8a7b6c5d-4e3f-2a1b-0c9d-8e7f6a5b4c3d/update/service-charge-agreement" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"service_charge_agreement\": 10,
    \"groceries\": true
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/restaurant/8a7b6c5d-4e3f-2a1b-0c9d-8e7f6a5b4c3d/update/service-charge-agreement"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "service_charge_agreement": 10,
    "groceries": true
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Admin - Settings

Update delivery rate

requires authentication

Set the Delivery Rate platform setting (percentage). The setting is created if it does not exist.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/delivery-rate/update" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"rate\": 10
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/delivery-rate/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "rate": 10
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

rate   number     

New value. Example: 10

Update base service charge rate

requires authentication

Set the Base Service Charge Rate platform setting (percentage). The setting is created if it does not exist.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/base-rate/update" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"rate\": 10
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/base-rate/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "rate": 10
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Admin - Users

List users by role

requires authentication

Paginated list (10 per page) of users with the given role, newest first, with their orders and restaurants (including restaurant orders, menus and users).

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/users/orderer?search=jane&page=1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/users/orderer"
);

const params = {
    "search": "jane",
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"status\": \"approved\",
    \"rejection_reason\": \"Driving licence has expired\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/users/rider/6f708192-a3b4-c5d6-e7f8-a9b0c1d2e3f4/status/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",

};

curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/users/update" \

    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "id=12"\
    --form "first_name=Jane"\
    --form "last_name=Doe"\
    --form "email=jane@example.com"\
    --form "phone_number=+447700900123"\
    --form "type=individual"\
    --form "avatar=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php92CE.tmp" 
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/users/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('id', '12');
body.append('first_name', 'Jane');
body.append('last_name', 'Doe');
body.append('email', 'jane@example.com');
body.append('phone_number', '+447700900123');
body.append('type', 'individual');
body.append('avatar', document.querySelector('input[name="avatar"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());

Paginated list of back-office users (any role other than orderer, restaurant, restaurant employee or rider, excluding the built-in admin accounts) with their roles and countries, plus all assignable roles.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/admins?per_page=15&page=1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/admins"
);

const params = {
    "per_page": "15",
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Authentication

Endpoints for registering, logging in (email/password or phone OTP), logging out, resetting passwords and fetching the authenticated user.

Login with email and password

Authenticates a user with email and password and issues a Sanctum API token for the given user type. Logging in as orderer automatically adds the orderer role to the user if missing. The user's role_id is set to the selected user type and the device token is updated when supplied. Riders whose profile is awaiting approval are rejected.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/login" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"email\": \"jane@example.com\",
    \"password\": \"secret123\",
    \"userType\": \"orderer\",
    \"device_token\": \"fcm-device-token-123\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/login"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "password": "secret123",
    "userType": "orderer",
    "device_token": "fcm-device-token-123"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Register a new user

Creates a user account (or reuses an existing one with the same email and phone), assigns the role matching userType, creates the related orderer/rider profile, and returns a Sanctum token. If a valid referral_code is supplied, its usage counter is incremented.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/register" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "name=Jane Doe"\
    --form "email=jane@example.com"\
    --form "password=secret123"\
    --form "userType=orderer"\
    --form "otp=123456"\
    --form "phone=254712345678"\
    --form "password_confirmation=secret123"\
    --form "device_token=fcm-device-token-123"\
    --form "referral_code=REF12345"\
    --form "type=restaurant"\
    --form "address=12 Moi Avenue"\
    --form "city=Nairobi"\
    --form "state=Nairobi"\
    --form "postal_code=00100"\
    --form "vehicle_license_plate=KDA 123A"\
    --form "paypal_email=rider@example.com"\
    --form "image=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php8B68.tmp" 
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/register"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('name', 'Jane Doe');
body.append('email', 'jane@example.com');
body.append('password', 'secret123');
body.append('userType', 'orderer');
body.append('otp', '123456');
body.append('phone', '254712345678');
body.append('password_confirmation', 'secret123');
body.append('device_token', 'fcm-device-token-123');
body.append('referral_code', 'REF12345');
body.append('type', 'restaurant');
body.append('address', '12 Moi Avenue');
body.append('city', 'Nairobi');
body.append('state', 'Nairobi');
body.append('postal_code', '00100');
body.append('vehicle_license_plate', 'KDA 123A');
body.append('paypal_email', 'rider@example.com');
body.append('image', document.querySelector('input[name="image"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());

Request a password reset code

Generates (or reuses) a 6-digit password reset code and sends it by email when email is given, otherwise by SMS to phone_number. One of email or phone_number is required.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/forgot-password" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"email\": \"jane@example.com\",
    \"phone_number\": \"254712345678\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/forgot-password"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "phone_number": "254712345678"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Request an OTP login code

Finds or creates a user with the given phone number, generates a one-time verification code and sends it by SMS. When latitude/longitude are provided the user's country is resolved via Google geocoding. Complete the login with the verify OTP endpoint.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/login/otp" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"phone_number\": \"254712345678\",
    \"userType\": \"orderer\",
    \"device_token\": \"fcm-device-token-123\",
    \"latitude\": \"-1.2847473\",
    \"longitude\": \"36.3878745\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/login/otp"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "phone_number": "254712345678",
    "userType": "orderer",
    "device_token": "fcm-device-token-123",
    "latitude": "-1.2847473",
    "longitude": "36.3878745"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Verify OTP and log in

Verifies the OTP code sent by the OTP login endpoint and issues a Sanctum token for the given user type. Riders must have a rider profile; riders awaiting approval receive a 200 response whose message is 403.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/login/otp/verify" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"code\": \"482913\",
    \"userType\": \"orderer\",
    \"device_token\": \"fcm-device-token-123\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/login/otp/verify"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "code": "482913",
    "userType": "orderer",
    "device_token": "fcm-device-token-123"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Admin login

Authenticate an admin (or other back-office user) with email and password and receive a Sanctum API token, the user's role and the full list of permissions the user holds. Note: validation failures are caught and returned with status 403 rather than 422.

curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/login" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"email\": \"admin@moboeats.co.uk\",
    \"password\": \"secret123\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/login"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "email": "admin@moboeats.co.uk",
    "password": "secret123"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Bookmarks

Customer bookmarks (favourites) for menu items.

Remove a menu bookmark

requires authentication

Deletes one of the authenticated customer's menu bookmarks. Only users with role orderer may call this. Reachable both as DELETE v1/orderer/menu-bookmark/{menu_bookmark} and GET v1/orderer/menu-bookmark/{menuId}/delete; in both cases the placeholder is the bookmark's numeric ID (not the menu ID).

requires authentication

    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/cart-items"
);

const params = {
    "uuid[eq]": "c7e1f9a2-3b4c-4d5e-9f60-718293a4b5c6",
    "status[eq]": "2",
    "cartId[eq]": "1",
    "menuId[eq]": "10",
    "quantity[eq]": "2",
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

};

}).then(response => response.json());

Add an item to the cart

requires authentication

Adds a menu item to the authenticated orderer's active cart, creating the cart if needed. Only users with role orderer may call this. Fails if the menu item is unavailable or already in the cart.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/cart-items" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"menuId\": 10,
    \"quantity\": 2,
    \"status\": 2
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/cart-items"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "menuId": 10,
    "quantity": 2,
    "status": 2
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a customer (orderer)

requires authentication

Creates a user with the orderer role and default password 12345678, plus the related orderer profile.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderers" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "name=Jane Doe"\
    --form "email=jane@example.com"\
    --form "phoneNo=254712345678"\
    --form "address=Moi Avenue"\
    --form "city=Nairobi"\
    --form "state=Nairobi"\
    --form "mapLocation=-1.2847,36.8219"\
    --form "image=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php8DBE.tmp" 
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderers"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('name', 'Jane Doe');
body.append('email', 'jane@example.com');
body.append('phoneNo', '254712345678');
body.append('address', 'Moi Avenue');
body.append('city', 'Nairobi');
body.append('state', 'Nairobi');
body.append('mapLocation', '-1.2847,36.8219');
body.append('image', document.querySelector('input[name="image"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());

Stripe checkout for a diet plan subscription

requires authentication

Subscribes the authenticated user to a diet subscription package. Reuses the user's current pending subscription or creates a new pending one (end date derived from the package duration), then creates a Stripe customer, ephemeral key and PaymentIntent in the package currency and stores a pending StripePayment. The Stripe webhook marks the subscription as paid. Body measurements are only required when the user's profile has neither height nor weight.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/diet/subscribe/2" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"height\": 175,
    \"height_units\": \"cm\",
    \"weight\": 70,
    \"weight_units\": \"kg\",
    \"body_mass_index\": 22.9
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/diet/subscribe/2"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "height": 175,
    "height_units": "cm",
    "weight": 70,
    "weight_units": "kg",
    "body_mass_index": 22.9
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Food Categories

Food (menu) categories such as "Burgers" or "Groceries". Categories group menu items and own a set of sub categories. Global categories have no restaurant_id; restaurant specific ones belong to a restaurant.

Get a food category

Returns a single food category with its sub categories and its menu items that belong to an approved, operating restaurant and have an active price. On GET /categories/{food_common_category} the category is looked up by uuid. Note: on the resource routes (/orderer/orderer-food-categories/{id}, /restaurant/food-categories/{id}) the route placeholder does not match the bound argument, so an empty category is returned. The path placeholder ({food_common_category} / {id}) is the category uuid, e.g. 0f8e2a3c-5b1d-4e7a-9c3f-2d6b8a1e4f70.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/categories/architecto" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/categories/architecto"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",

    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a food category

Creates a new active food category (status is always set to 2) and stores the optional image. The creator is taken from the authenticated user, so the call fails with 403 when no user is authenticated (the public /categories and /orderer/orderer-food-categories routes have no auth middleware). Returns the first page of all categories (7 per page). Also used by admins via POST /admin/categories/add.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/categories" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Burgers\",
    \"description\": \"Burgers and sandwiches\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"restaurant_id\": 3
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/categories"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Burgers",
    "description": "Burgers and sandwiches",
    "status": 2,
    "restaurant_id": 3
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Get a food category

Returns a single food category with its sub categories and its menu items that belong to an approved, operating restaurant and have an active price. On GET /categories/{food_common_category} the category is looked up by uuid. Note: on the resource routes (/orderer/orderer-food-categories/{id}, /restaurant/food-categories/{id}) the route placeholder does not match the bound argument, so an empty category is returned. The path placeholder ({food_common_category} / {id}) is the category uuid, e.g. 0f8e2a3c-5b1d-4e7a-9c3f-2d6b8a1e4f70.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/categories/architecto" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/categories/architecto"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Update a food category

Updates the title, description and (optionally) the image of a food category, then returns the first page of all categories (7 per page). With PUT both title and description are required; with PATCH/POST they are optional (omitted values are saved as null). Also used by admins via POST /admin/categories/update/{id}.

Example request:
curl --request PUT \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/categories/architecto" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Burgers\",
    \"description\": \"Burgers and sandwiches\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/categories/architecto"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Burgers",
    "description": "Burgers and sandwiches"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a food category

Creates a new active food category (status is always set to 2) and stores the optional image. The creator is taken from the authenticated user, so the call fails with 403 when no user is authenticated (the public /categories and /orderer/orderer-food-categories routes have no auth middleware). Returns the first page of all categories (7 per page). Also used by admins via POST /admin/categories/add.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-food-categories" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Burgers\",
    \"description\": \"Burgers and sandwiches\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"restaurant_id\": 3
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-food-categories"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Burgers",
    "description": "Burgers and sandwiches",
    "status": 2,
    "restaurant_id": 3
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Get a food category

Returns a single food category with its sub categories and its menu items that belong to an approved, operating restaurant and have an active price. On GET /categories/{food_common_category} the category is looked up by uuid. Note: on the resource routes (/orderer/orderer-food-categories/{id}, /restaurant/food-categories/{id}) the route placeholder does not match the bound argument, so an empty category is returned. The path placeholder ({food_common_category} / {id}) is the category uuid, e.g. 0f8e2a3c-5b1d-4e7a-9c3f-2d6b8a1e4f70.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-food-categories/architecto" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-food-categories/architecto"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Update a food category

Updates the title, description and (optionally) the image of a food category, then returns the first page of all categories (7 per page). With PUT both title and description are required; with PATCH/POST they are optional (omitted values are saved as null). Also used by admins via POST /admin/categories/update/{id}.

Example request:
curl --request PUT \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-food-categories/architecto" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Burgers\",
    \"description\": \"Burgers and sandwiches\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-food-categories/architecto"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Burgers",
    "description": "Burgers and sandwiches"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

List food categories

requires authentication

Returns a paginated list (15 per page) of food categories that have at least one active menu item with an active price. Each category includes its sub categories and its menu items that belong to an approved, operating restaurant and have an active price. Available publicly (/categories, /orderer/orderer-food-categories) and to restaurant users (/restaurant/food-categories).

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/food-categories?uuid%5Beq%5D=0f8e2a3c-5b1d-4e7a-9c3f-2d6b8a1e4f70&title%5Beq%5D=Burgers&status%5Beq%5D=2&page=1&includeSubcategories=1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/food-categories"
);

const params = {
    "uuid[eq]": "0f8e2a3c-5b1d-4e7a-9c3f-2d6b8a1e4f70",
    "title[eq]": "Burgers",
    "status[eq]": "2",
    "page": "1",
    "includeSubcategories": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a food category

requires authentication

}"

    "status": 2,
    "restaurant_id": 3
};

Get a food category

requires authentication

Returns a single food category with its sub categories and its menu items that belong to an approved, operating restaurant and have an active price. On GET /categories/{food_common_category} the category is looked up by uuid. Note: on the resource routes (/orderer/orderer-food-categories/{id}, /restaurant/food-categories/{id}) the route placeholder does not match the bound argument, so an empty category is returned. The path placeholder ({food_common_category} / {id}) is the category uuid, e.g. 0f8e2a3c-5b1d-4e7a-9c3f-2d6b8a1e4f70.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/food-categories/architecto" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"

);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Update a food sub category

Updates a sub category (looked up by uuid), optionally replaces its image and re-syncs the food categories it belongs to. With PUT, title, description and categoryIds are required. If anything fails the change is rolled back and an empty 200 response is returned. Note: only /restaurant/food-sub-categories/{id} binds the sub category; on the other routes the placeholder does not match the bound argument.

Example request:
curl --request PUT \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/sub-categories/architecto" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Beef Burgers\",
    \"description\": \"Beef patty burgers\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"updatedBy\": \"owner@example.com\",
    \"categoryIds\": [
        1,
        2
    ]
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/sub-categories/architecto"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Beef Burgers",
    "description": "Beef patty burgers",
    "status": 2,
    "updatedBy": "owner@example.com",
    "categoryIds": [
        1,
        2
    ]
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Update a food sub category

Updates a sub category (looked up by uuid), optionally replaces its image and re-syncs the food categories it belongs to. With PUT, title, description and categoryIds are required. If anything fails the change is rolled back and an empty 200 response is returned. Note: only /restaurant/food-sub-categories/{id} binds the sub category; on the other routes the placeholder does not match the bound argument.

    \"status\": 2,
    \"updatedBy\": \"owner@example.com\",

}"

};

    ]
};

    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/food-sub-categories?uuid%5Beq%5D=7c6b5a49-3827-4165-9e0d-1c2b3a4f5e6d&title%5Beq%5D=Beef+Burgers&status%5Beq%5D=2&page=1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/food-sub-categories"
);

const params = {
    "uuid[eq]": "7c6b5a49-3827-4165-9e0d-1c2b3a4f5e6d",
    "title[eq]": "Beef Burgers",
    "status[eq]": "2",
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",

    "Accept": "application/json",

Bulk create food sub categories

requires authentication

Creates several sub categories at once. The request body is a JSON array; each item is created and attached to its categoryIds. Only users with a restaurant may call this.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/food-sub-categories/bulk" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "[
    {
        \"title\": \"Beef Burgers\",
        \"description\": \"Beef patty burgers\",
        \"status\": 2,
        \"createdBy\": \"owner@example.com\",
        \"categoryIds\": [
            1
        ]
    }
]"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/food-sub-categories/bulk"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = [
    {
        "title": "Beef Burgers",
        "description": "Beef patty burgers",
        "status": 2,
        "createdBy": "owner@example.com",
        "categoryIds": [
            1
        ]
    }
];

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Menus

Restaurant menu items (dishes and grocery products): browsing for customers, and management (create, update, images, prices, import/export, reviews) for restaurant owners. Grocery items are menu items in the "groceries" category.

List grocery items

Returns menu items in the "groceries" category (10 per page). Guests and customers (orderer role) get active items with an active price. On the authenticated /restaurant/groceries route, restaurant users get the grocery items of their restaurants together with the available categories and their restaurants, and restaurant employee users get their restaurant's grocery items. Other roles get an empty response.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/groceries?page=1" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/groceries"
);

const params = {
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

When called by an authenticated restaurant user it returns that user's grocery items, categories and restaurants instead.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/groceries/categories" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"

    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/groceries/categories"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

List menu items

Returns a paginated list of menu items with their restaurant, prices, categories (with sub categories), images and discount. Guests and customers get active menu items with an active price and at least one image from approved restaurants, limited to restaurants within 1000 km when coordinates are known (query lat/lng, or the customer's saved location). On the authenticated /restaurant/menu route, users with role restaurant get all menu items of their own restaurants and restaurant employee users get their restaurant's items.

    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-menu?lat=51.5072&lng=-0.1276&per_page=20&page=1" \

    "page": "1",
};

    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a menu item for a restaurant

Creates an active menu item for the restaurant in the path placeholder {id} (restaurant uuid or numeric id), with an optional standard price and image, attaches categories/sub categories and creates the matching Stripe product (and price). Only users with role restaurant or the edit partners permission may call this. Used by POST /restaurant/{id}/menu/add and POST /admin/restaurant/{id}/menu/add. Note: the resource routes POST /restaurant/menu and POST /orderer/orderer-menu have no {id} and therefore fail.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-menu" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Chicken Burger\",
    \"description\": \"Grilled chicken burger with fries\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"categoryIds\": [
        1
    ],
    \"preparation_time\": 20,
    \"subcategoryIds\": [
        4
    ],
    \"standardPrice\": 1250
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-menu"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Chicken Burger",
    "description": "Grilled chicken burger with fries",
    "status": 2,
    "categoryIds": [
        1
    ],
    "preparation_time": 20,
    "subcategoryIds": [
        4
    ],
    "standardPrice": 1250
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Update a menu item

Updates a menu item's attributes, standard price (first price), main image and categories/sub categories, and creates or updates its Stripe product. Available as POST /restaurant/menu/{id}/update and POST /admin/restaurant/menu/{id}/update (numeric menu id), PUT/PATCH /restaurant/menu/{uuid} (menu uuid) and PUT/PATCH /orderer/orderer-menu/{id} (numeric id). Any error rolls back and returns 403.

Example request:
curl --request PUT \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-menu/architecto" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Chicken Burger\",
    \"description\": \"Grilled chicken burger with fries\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"categoryIds\": [
        1
    ],
    \"preparation_time\": 20,
    \"subcategoryIds\": [
        4
    ],
    \"standardPrice\": 12.5
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-menu/architecto"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Chicken Burger",
    "description": "Grilled chicken burger with fries",
    "status": 2,
    "categoryIds": [
        1
    ],
    "preparation_time": 20,
    "subcategoryIds": [
        4
    ],
    "standardPrice": 12.5
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Headers

Content-Type        

Example: application/json

Accept        

Example: application/json

URL Parameters

orderer_menu   string     

Example: architecto

Body Parameters

title   string  optional    

The menu item name. Example: Chicken Burger

description   string  optional    

The menu item description. Example: Grilled chicken burger with fries

status   integer  optional    

Status: 1 = inactive, 2 = active. Example: 2

categoryIds   integer[]  optional    

Ids of the food categories (the categories are re-synced; needed by the code).

preparation_time   integer  optional    

Preparation time in minutes. Example: 20

subcategoryIds   integer[]  optional    

Ids of the food sub categories (re-synced when sent).

standardPrice   number  optional    

New amount for the menu item's first price. Example: 12.5

A new main image.

Response Fields

data   object     

The updated menu item.

List menu items

requires authentication

Returns a paginated list of menu items with their restaurant, prices, categories (with sub categories), images and discount. Guests and customers get active menu items with an active price and at least one image from approved restaurants, limited to restaurants within 1000 km when coordinates are known (query lat/lng, or the customer's saved location). On the authenticated /restaurant/menu route, users with role restaurant get all menu items of their own restaurants and restaurant employee users get their restaurant's items.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu?lat=51.5072&lng=-0.1276&per_page=20&page=1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu"
);

const params = {
    "lat": "51.5072",
    "lng": "-0.1276",
    "per_page": "20",
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a menu item for a restaurant

requires authentication

Creates an active menu item for the restaurant in the path placeholder {id} (restaurant uuid or numeric id), with an optional standard price and image, attaches categories/sub categories and creates the matching Stripe product (and price). Only users with role restaurant or the edit partners permission may call this. Used by POST /restaurant/{id}/menu/add and POST /admin/restaurant/{id}/menu/add. Note: the resource routes POST /restaurant/menu and POST /orderer/orderer-menu have no {id} and therefore fail.

Get a menu item

requires authentication

Returns a menu item (looked up by uuid) with prices, categories, sub categories, images, discount, reviews and order items (grouped by order id). The response is not wrapped in data. When authenticated as a restaurant or restaurant employee user (on /restaurant/menu/{id}), the food categories available to the restaurant are returned too.

    --header "Accept: application/json"

);

    "Content-Type": "application/json",

};

Update a menu item

requires authentication

Updates a menu item's attributes, standard price (first price), main image and categories/sub categories, and creates or updates its Stripe product. Available as POST /restaurant/menu/{id}/update and POST /admin/restaurant/menu/{id}/update (numeric menu id), PUT/PATCH /restaurant/menu/{uuid} (menu uuid) and PUT/PATCH /orderer/orderer-menu/{id} (numeric id). Any error rolls back and returns 403.

Example request:
curl --request PUT \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu/architecto" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Chicken Burger\",
    \"description\": \"Grilled chicken burger with fries\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"categoryIds\": [
        1
    ],
    \"preparation_time\": 20,
    \"subcategoryIds\": [
        4
    ],
    \"standardPrice\": 12.5
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu/architecto"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Chicken Burger",
    "description": "Grilled chicken burger with fries",
    "status": 2,
    "categoryIds": [
        1
    ],
    "preparation_time": 20,
    "subcategoryIds": [
        4
    ],
    "standardPrice": 12.5
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

List grocery items

requires authentication

Returns menu items in the "groceries" category (10 per page). Guests and customers (orderer role) get active items with an active price. On the authenticated /restaurant/groceries route, restaurant users get the grocery items of their restaurants together with the available categories and their restaurants, and restaurant employee users get their restaurant's grocery items. Other roles get an empty response.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/groceries?page=1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/groceries"
);

const params = {
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Export grocery items

requires authentication

Generates an Excel (.xlsx) export of grocery items and downloads it. Note: the code calls an undefined unique() helper, so this currently fails with a server error.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/groceries/export/data?search=burger" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/groceries/export/data"
);

const params = {
    "search": "burger",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a menu item for a restaurant

requires authentication

Creates an active menu item for the restaurant in the path placeholder {id} (restaurant uuid or numeric id), with an optional standard price and image, attaches categories/sub categories and creates the matching Stripe product (and price). Only users with role restaurant or the edit partners permission may call this. Used by POST /restaurant/{id}/menu/add and POST /admin/restaurant/{id}/menu/add. Note: the resource routes POST /restaurant/menu and POST /orderer/orderer-menu have no {id} and therefore fail.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/architecto/menu/add" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Chicken Burger\",
    \"description\": \"Grilled chicken burger with fries\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"categoryIds\": [
        1
    ],
    \"preparation_time\": 20,
    \"subcategoryIds\": [
        4
    ],
    \"standardPrice\": 1250
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/architecto/menu/add"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Chicken Burger",
    "description": "Grilled chicken burger with fries",
    "status": 2,
    "categoryIds": [
        1
    ],
    "preparation_time": 20,
    "subcategoryIds": [
        4
    ],
    "standardPrice": 1250
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Update a menu item

requires authentication

Updates a menu item's attributes, standard price (first price), main image and categories/sub categories, and creates or updates its Stripe product. Available as POST /restaurant/menu/{id}/update and POST /admin/restaurant/menu/{id}/update (numeric menu id), PUT/PATCH /restaurant/menu/{uuid} (menu uuid) and PUT/PATCH /orderer/orderer-menu/{id} (numeric id). Any error rolls back and returns 403.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu/architecto/update" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Chicken Burger\",
    \"description\": \"Grilled chicken burger with fries\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"categoryIds\": [
        1
    ],
    \"preparation_time\": 20,
    \"subcategoryIds\": [
        4
    ],
    \"standardPrice\": 12.5
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu/architecto/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Chicken Burger",
    "description": "Grilled chicken burger with fries",
    "status": 2,
    "categoryIds": [
        1
    ],
    "preparation_time": 20,
    "subcategoryIds": [
        4
    ],
    "standardPrice": 12.5
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a menu item in several restaurants

requires authentication

Creates the same menu item (with images, categories, optional standard price and a Stripe product/price) in each of the given restaurants. Send as multipart/form-data; the id lists are JSON-encoded strings. Any failure (including missing images) rolls everything back and returns 403.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu/create" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"restaurant_ids\": \"[3,5]\",
    \"title\": \"Chicken Burger\",
    \"description\": \"Grilled chicken burger with fries\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"categoryIds\": \"[1]\",
    \"preparation_time\": 20,
    \"subcategoryIds\": \"[4]\",
    \"standardPrice\": 1250,
    \"images\": null
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu/create"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "restaurant_ids": "[3,5]",
    "title": "Chicken Burger",
    "description": "Grilled chicken burger with fries",
    "status": 2,
    "categoryIds": "[1]",
    "preparation_time": 20,
    "subcategoryIds": "[4]",
    "standardPrice": 1250,
    "images": null
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Bulk upload menu items

requires authentication

Imports menu items from an Excel file based on the menu template (columns such as title, description, branches, categories, active). Branches must be restaurants owned by the user; missing categories are created. JSON responses are only returned when the request accepts JSON; otherwise the response is empty.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu/upload" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "file=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php90AA.tmp" 
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu/upload"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('file', document.querySelector('input[name="file"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a menu item for a restaurant

requires authentication

Creates an active menu item for the restaurant in the path placeholder {id} (restaurant uuid or numeric id), with an optional standard price and image, attaches categories/sub categories and creates the matching Stripe product (and price). Only users with role restaurant or the edit partners permission may call this. Used by POST /restaurant/{id}/menu/add and POST /admin/restaurant/{id}/menu/add. Note: the resource routes POST /restaurant/menu and POST /orderer/orderer-menu have no {id} and therefore fail.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/restaurant/architecto/menu/add" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Chicken Burger\",
    \"description\": \"Grilled chicken burger with fries\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"categoryIds\": [
        1
    ],
    \"preparation_time\": 20,
    \"subcategoryIds\": [
        4
    ],
    \"standardPrice\": 1250
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/restaurant/architecto/menu/add"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "title": "Chicken Burger",
    "description": "Grilled chicken burger with fries",
    "status": 2,
    "categoryIds": [
        1
    ],
    "preparation_time": 20,
    "subcategoryIds": [
        4
    ],
    "standardPrice": 1250
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Update a menu item

requires authentication

Updates a menu item's attributes, standard price (first price), main image and categories/sub categories, and creates or updates its Stripe product. Available as POST /restaurant/menu/{id}/update and POST /admin/restaurant/menu/{id}/update (numeric menu id), PUT/PATCH /restaurant/menu/{uuid} (menu uuid) and PUT/PATCH /orderer/orderer-menu/{id} (numeric id). Any error rolls back and returns 403.

    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/restaurant/menu/architecto/update" \

    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"title\": \"Chicken Burger\",
    \"description\": \"Grilled chicken burger with fries\",
    \"status\": 2,
    \"categoryIds\": [
        1
    ],
    \"preparation_time\": 20,
    \"subcategoryIds\": [

Menu prices Prices of restaurant menu items. A menu item can have several prices but only one active (status `2`) price; prices are mirrored to Stripe as Stripe prices of the menu item's Stripe product.

List menu prices

requires authentication

Returns a paginated list (15 per page) of menu prices, optionally filtered.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu-prices?uuid%5Beq%5D=c4d5e6f7-8a9b-4c0d-9e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f&menuId%5Beq%5D=4&price%5Beq%5D=12.5&description%5Beq%5D=standard&status%5Beq%5D=2&menu=1&page=1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/menu-prices"
);

const params = {
    "uuid[eq]": "c4d5e6f7-8a9b-4c0d-9e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f",
    "menuId[eq]": "4",
    "price[eq]": "12.5",
    "description[eq]": "standard",
    "status[eq]": "2",
    "menu": "1",
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a menu price

requires authentication

Adds a price to a menu item. Only users with role restaurant or the edit partners permission may call this. When status is 2 all other prices of the menu item are set inactive. Creates the menu item's Stripe product if missing and, when standardPrice is sent, a Stripe price. The change is logged in the activity log.

    --header "Accept: application/json" \

}"

};

    "status": 2,
    "menu_id": 4
};

Send a message

requires authentication

Sends a message to another user, creating a direct conversation between the two users if one does not exist. Participants are notified in the background.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/message/send" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"receiver_id\": 1,
    \"message\": \"Hello, where is my order?\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/message/send"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "receiver_id": 1,
    "message": "Hello, where is my order?"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Reply to a conversation

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/conversation/7/reply" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"message\": \"Thanks, received!\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/conversation/7/reply"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "message": "Thanks, received!"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Orders

Customer and restaurant order endpoints: placing orders and dine-in reservations, listing and viewing orders, updating order/reservation status, assigning tables and riders, and exporting orders.

List orders

requires authentication

Returns the authenticated user's orders, newest first, paginated 10 per page. Customers (orderer) see their own orders; users with role restaurant see orders of all their restaurants; restaurant employee users see orders of the restaurant they work for. The search/date/delivery filters apply only to restaurant owners and employees (booking date filters only to restaurant owners).

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orders?uuid%5Beq%5D=9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d&status%5Beq%5D=2&userId%5Beq%5D=12&restaurantId%5Beq%5D=3&search=Jane&from_created_at=2024-01-01&to_created_at=2024-01-31&delivery=1&from_booking_date=2024-01-01&to_booking_date=2024-01-31&page=1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orders"
);

const params = {
    "uuid[eq]": "9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d",
    "status[eq]": "2",
    "userId[eq]": "12",
    "restaurantId[eq]": "3",
    "search": "Jane",
    "from_created_at": "2024-01-01",
    "to_created_at": "2024-01-31",
    "delivery": "1",
    "from_booking_date": "2024-01-01",
    "to_booking_date": "2024-01-31",
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

        {
            "id": 10,
            "uuid": "9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d",
            "attributes": {
                "userId": 12,
                "totalAmount": "25.50",
                "delivery": true,

Place an order

requires authentication

Only users with role orderer may call this. If cartId matches one of the user's carts, the cart items are turned into order items, menu discounts and an optional promo code are applied, a service charge is added, and a delivery fee is computed for deliveries (from the delivery coordinates) or orphanage deliveries (via Google Distance Matrix); the cart is then deleted. If no cart matches, a dine-in reservation order is created instead (requires seating_area_id, seat_number and booking_time).

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orders" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"cartId\": 5,
    \"restaurantId\": 3,
    \"delivery\": true,
    \"delivery_address\": \"221B Baker Street, London\",
    \"delivery_location_lat\": 51.5237,
    \"delivery_location_lng\": -0.1585,
    \"booking_time\": \"2030-01-15 19:30\",
    \"promo_code\": \"SAVE10\",
    \"orphanage_id\": 2,
    \"seating_area_id\": 1,
    \"seat_number\": 4
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orders"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "cartId": 5,
    "restaurantId": 3,
    "delivery": true,
    "delivery_address": "221B Baker Street, London",
    "delivery_location_lat": 51.5237,
    "delivery_location_lng": -0.1585,
    "booking_time": "2030-01-15 19:30",
    "promo_code": "SAVE10",
    "orphanage_id": 2,
    "seating_area_id": 1,
    "seat_number": 4
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Delivery longitude. Required if delivery is true. Example: -0.1585

booking_time   string  optional    

Dining/booking time in Y-m-d H:i, must be in the future. Required if delivery is false, and for reservations. Example: 2030-01-15 19:30

promo_code   string  optional    

A promo code for the restaurant. Example: SAVE10

orphanage_id   integer  optional    

The id of an orphanage to deliver the order to. Example: 2

seating_area_id   integer  optional    

Seating area id. Required for dine-in reservations (no cart). Example: 1

seat_number   integer  optional    

Number of seats. Required for dine-in reservations (no cart). Example: 4

Get an order

requires authentication

Returns a single order. For users with role restaurant or restaurant employee the raw order (with restaurant, rider, items, reservation, tables, payment and orphanage) is returned together with the restaurant's tables and, for delivery orders, a list of available riders with their distance/time from the restaurant. Other users get the order as an order resource. Returns an empty body unless the request accepts JSON.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orders/9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orders/9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

    --header "Accept: application/json" \

}"

);

};

List orders

requires authentication

Returns the authenticated user's orders, newest first, paginated 10 per page. Customers (orderer) see their own orders; users with role restaurant see orders of all their restaurants; restaurant employee users see orders of the restaurant they work for. The search/date/delivery filters apply only to restaurant owners and employees (booking date filters only to restaurant owners).

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/orders?uuid%5Beq%5D=9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d&status%5Beq%5D=2&userId%5Beq%5D=12&restaurantId%5Beq%5D=3&search=Jane&from_created_at=2024-01-01&to_created_at=2024-01-31&delivery=1&from_booking_date=2024-01-01&to_booking_date=2024-01-31&page=1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/orders"
);

const params = {
    "uuid[eq]": "9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d",
    "status[eq]": "2",
    "userId[eq]": "12",
    "restaurantId[eq]": "3",
    "search": "Jane",
    "from_created_at": "2024-01-01",
    "to_created_at": "2024-01-31",
    "delivery": "1",
    "from_booking_date": "2024-01-01",
    "to_booking_date": "2024-01-31",
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Payments

Payment endpoints: Stripe, M-Pesa (PochiPay) and PayPal checkouts for orders, rider tips, supplement orders and diet plan subscriptions, plus the provider webhooks/callbacks that confirm payments.

Stripe webhook

Receives Stripe event notifications. Only events whose data.object.object is charge are handled; the charge's payment_intent is matched to a stored StripePayment. On charge.succeeded the payment is marked successful and, depending on what was paid for, the order is marked paid (status 2), assigned to a rider and the restaurant notified; or the rider tip is marked paid; or the supplement order is marked paid; or the diet subscription is marked paid. A Payment record is created (except for diet subscriptions) and the user is notified. On charge.payment_failed the user is notified. Unmatched or unhandled events return an empty 200 response. Called by Stripe, not by API clients.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/stripe/webhook" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"id\": \"evt_3OabcXYZ\",
    \"type\": \"charge.succeeded\",
    \"data\": {
        \"object\": {
            \"object\": \"charge\",
            \"id\": \"ch_3OabcXYZ\",
            \"payment_intent\": \"pi_3OabcXYZ\"
        }
    }
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/stripe/webhook"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "id": "evt_3OabcXYZ",
    "type": "charge.succeeded",
    "data": {
        "object": {
            "object": "charge",
            "id": "ch_3OabcXYZ",
            "payment_intent": "pi_3OabcXYZ"
        }
    }
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Example response (200, Payment processed):


{
    "message": "Successful Payment"
}

Example response (200, Event ignored):


""

Checkout an order (Stripe or M-Pesa)

requires authentication

Starts payment for the authenticated customer's order. For restaurants outside Kenya a Stripe customer, ephemeral key and PaymentIntent are created (amount rounded up to .30/next whole unit) and a pending StripePayment is stored; the client completes payment with the Stripe SDK and the Stripe webhook confirms it. For restaurants in Kenya an M-Pesa STK push is sent via PochiPay to the customer's phone and the PochiPay callback confirms it. The mode placeholder is accepted but currently ignored.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/stripe/checkout/10/pochipay" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/stripe/checkout/10/pochipay"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

PochiPay (M-Pesa) callback

Receives the result of an M-Pesa collection initiated through PochiPay. The order is matched by the uuid prefix in billRefNumber. On success the order is marked paid (status 2), assigned to a rider, the restaurant and customer are notified and a Mobile Money payment is recorded. Called by PochiPay, not by API clients.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/pochipay/callback" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"billRefNumber\": \"9b1deb4d\",
    \"thirdPartyReference\": \"SAB1CD2EFG\",
    \"isSuccessful\": true,
    \"failReason\": \"Request cancelled by user\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/pochipay/callback"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "billRefNumber": "9b1deb4d",
    "thirdPartyReference": "SAB1CD2EFG",
    "isSuccessful": true,
    "failReason": "Request cancelled by user"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Example response (200, Payment recorded):


{
    "status": "Request was succesful",
    "message": "Successful Payment",
    "data": ""
}

Example response (400, Payment failed or order not found):


{
    "status": "Error has occured...",
    "message": "Payment was not successful",
    "data": "Request cancelled by user"
}

{
    "message": {

        ]
    }
}

Restaurant Management

Restaurant listings, details, registration and the restaurant owner/employee panel (dashboard, tables, reservations, payments, categories, employees). Endpoints under /v1/restaurant (except registering a restaurant) pass through the has_restaurant middleware, which returns 422 {"data":"no_restaurant"} when a user with role restaurant has not registered any restaurant yet.

List restaurants

Returns a paginated list of restaurants. The result depends on the caller: guests (GET /v1/restaurants, GET /v1/orderer/orderer-restaurants) and users with role orderer get approved restaurants (sorted by distance within 200,000 km when lat/lng are given) with questionnaire, reviews and tables loaded; role rider (GET /v1/rider/restaurants) gets approved restaurants filtered by the filter params (15 per page); role restaurant (GET /v1/restaurant/restaurants) gets only their own restaurants (any status, 10 per page, newest first) with orders and menus; role restaurant employee gets the single restaurant they are assigned to.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurants?lat=-1.2833&lng=36.8167&per_page=20&search=Kitchen&status=2&uuid%5Beq%5D=9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b&name%5Beq%5D=Mama%27s+Kitchen&nameShort%5Beq%5D=MK&email%5Beq%5D=info%40mamaskitchen.co.ke&aboutShort%5Beq%5D=Kenyan+cuisine&phoneNo%5Beq%5D=%2B254712345678&address%5Beq%5D=Moi+Avenue%2C+Nairobi&city%5Beq%5D=Nairobi&state%5Beq%5D=Nairobi&mapLocation%5Beq%5D=Nairobi&latitude%5Bgt%5D=-1.5&longitude%5Blt%5D=37.0&postalCode%5Beq%5D=00100" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurants"
);

const params = {
    "lat": "-1.2833",
    "lng": "36.8167",
    "per_page": "20",
    "search": "Kitchen",
    "status": "2",
    "uuid[eq]": "9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b",
    "name[eq]": "Mama's Kitchen",
    "nameShort[eq]": "MK",
    "email[eq]": "info@mamaskitchen.co.ke",
    "aboutShort[eq]": "Kenyan cuisine",
    "phoneNo[eq]": "+254712345678",
    "address[eq]": "Moi Avenue, Nairobi",
    "city[eq]": "Nairobi",
    "state[eq]": "Nairobi",
    "mapLocation[eq]": "Nairobi",
    "latitude[gt]": "-1.5",
    "longitude[lt]": "37.0",
    "postalCode[eq]": "00100",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());
