Request      

GET api/v3/restaurants

Headers

Content-Type        

Example: application/json

Accept        

Example: application/json

Query Parameters

lat   number  optional    

Latitude of the user, used with lng to sort guests/orderers by distance. Example: -1.2833

lng   number  optional    

Longitude of the user, used with lat. Example: 36.8167

per_page   integer  optional    

Items per page for guests/orderers. Defaults to 100. Example: 20

search   string  optional    

Restaurant/employee callers only: search by name or address. Example: Kitchen

status   string  optional    

Role restaurant only: filter own restaurants by raw status (1 = Pending, 2 = Approved, 3 = Denied). Orderers/riders may instead use the filter syntax status[eq]. Example: 2

uuid[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by restaurant UUID. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: 9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b

name[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact restaurant name. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Mama's Kitchen

nameShort[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact short name. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: MK

email[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact email. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: info@mamaskitchen.co.ke

aboutShort[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact short description. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Kenyan cuisine

phoneNo[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact phone number. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: +254712345678

address[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact address. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Moi Avenue, Nairobi

city[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by city. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Nairobi

state[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by state/county. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Nairobi

mapLocation[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by map location (operators: eq, gt, lt). Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Nairobi

latitude[gt]   string  optional    

Filter by latitude (operators: eq, gt, lt). Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: -1.5

longitude[lt]   string  optional    

Filter by longitude (operators: eq, gt, lt). Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: 37.0

postalCode[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by postal code (operators: eq, gt, lt). Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: 00100

data   object[]

List restaurants

Returns a paginated list of restaurants. The result depends on the caller: guests (GET /v1/restaurants, GET /v1/orderer/orderer-restaurants) and users with role orderer get approved restaurants (sorted by distance within 200,000 km when lat/lng are given) with questionnaire, reviews and tables loaded; role rider (GET /v1/rider/restaurants) gets approved restaurants filtered by the filter params (15 per page); role restaurant (GET /v1/restaurant/restaurants) gets only their own restaurants (any status, 10 per page, newest first) with orders and menus; role restaurant employee gets the single restaurant they are assigned to.

Creates a restaurant owned by the authenticated user (served by POST /v1/restaurant/restaurant and the restaurants resource routes). The restaurant role is added to the user if missing. Show restaurant details

Returns a single restaurant with operating hours, reviews and tables (with seating areas). Update a restaurant

Updates the restaurant details. Served to restaurant owners/employees (PUT /v1/restaurant/restaurants/{restaurant}, POST /v1/restaurant/restaurants/{restaurant}/update), riders (resource route) and admins (POST /v1/admin/restaurants/{restaurant}/update). Users with role orderer get 401. When latitude/longitude are sent the country is resolved via Google Geocoding. If a restaurant/employee updates a Pending or Denied restaurant, a Denied one is moved back to Pending and the admin is notified; an admin update sets the status to Approved. Send as multipart/form-data (with POST) when uploading a logo.

Example request:
curl --request PUT \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-restaurants/architecto" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "name=Mama's Kitchen"\
    --form "name_short=MK"\
    --form "email=info@mamaskitchen.co.ke"\
    --form "about=Authentic Kenyan cuisine served fresh daily."\
    --form "about_short=Kenyan cuisine"\
    --form "phone_no=+254712345678"\
    --form "address=Moi Avenue, Nairobi"\
    --form "state=Nairobi"\
    --form "postal_code=00100"\
    --form "map_location=Nairobi"\
    --form "url=https://mamaskitchen.co.ke"\
    --form "latitude=-1.2833"\
    --form "longitude=36.8167"\
    --form "city=Nairobi"\
    --form "paypal_email=payouts@mamaskitchen.co.ke"\
    --form "logo=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php8D21.tmp" 
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-restaurants/architecto"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('name', 'Mama's Kitchen');
body.append('name_short', 'MK');
body.append('email', 'info@mamaskitchen.co.ke');
body.append('about', 'Authentic Kenyan cuisine served fresh daily.');
body.append('about_short', 'Kenyan cuisine');
body.append('phone_no', '+254712345678');
body.append('address', 'Moi Avenue, Nairobi');
body.append('state', 'Nairobi');
body.append('postal_code', '00100');
body.append('map_location', 'Nairobi');
body.append('url', 'https://mamaskitchen.co.ke');
body.append('latitude', '-1.2833');
body.append('longitude', '36.8167');
body.append('city', 'Nairobi');
body.append('paypal_email', 'payouts@mamaskitchen.co.ke');
body.append('logo', document.querySelector('input[name="logo"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());

curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/orderer-restaurants/9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b/tables?page=1" \

    --header "Accept: application/json"

);

const params = {
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Review a restaurant

requires authentication

Stores a rating (and optional review text) by the authenticated user for a restaurant and recalculates the restaurant's average rating.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/restaurant/reviews/store" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"restaurant_id\": 1,
    \"rating\": 5,
    \"review\": \"Great food and fast service!\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/restaurant/reviews/store"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "restaurant_id": 1,
    "rating": 5,
    "review": "Great food and fast service!"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

List restaurants

requires authentication

Returns a paginated list of restaurants. The result depends on the caller: guests (GET /v1/restaurants, GET /v1/orderer/orderer-restaurants) and users with role orderer get approved restaurants (sorted by distance within 200,000 km when lat/lng are given) with questionnaire, reviews and tables loaded; role rider (GET /v1/rider/restaurants) gets approved restaurants filtered by the filter params (15 per page); role restaurant (GET /v1/restaurant/restaurants) gets only their own restaurants (any status, 10 per page, newest first) with orders and menus; role restaurant employee gets the single restaurant they are assigned to.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/rider/restaurants?lat=-1.2833&lng=36.8167&per_page=20&search=Kitchen&status=2&uuid%5Beq%5D=9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b&name%5Beq%5D=Mama%27s+Kitchen&nameShort%5Beq%5D=MK&email%5Beq%5D=info%40mamaskitchen.co.ke&aboutShort%5Beq%5D=Kenyan+cuisine&phoneNo%5Beq%5D=%2B254712345678&address%5Beq%5D=Moi+Avenue%2C+Nairobi&city%5Beq%5D=Nairobi&state%5Beq%5D=Nairobi&mapLocation%5Beq%5D=Nairobi&latitude%5Bgt%5D=-1.5&longitude%5Blt%5D=37.0&postalCode%5Beq%5D=00100" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/rider/restaurants"
);

const params = {
    "lat": "-1.2833",
    "lng": "36.8167",
    "per_page": "20",
    "search": "Kitchen",
    "status": "2",
    "uuid[eq]": "9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b",
    "name[eq]": "Mama's Kitchen",
    "nameShort[eq]": "MK",
    "email[eq]": "info@mamaskitchen.co.ke",
    "aboutShort[eq]": "Kenyan cuisine",
    "phoneNo[eq]": "+254712345678",
    "address[eq]": "Moi Avenue, Nairobi",
    "city[eq]": "Nairobi",
    "state[eq]": "Nairobi",
    "mapLocation[eq]": "Nairobi",
    "latitude[gt]": "-1.5",
    "longitude[lt]": "37.0",
    "postalCode[eq]": "00100",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",

Role restaurant only: filter own restaurants by raw status (1 = Pending, 2 = Approved, 3 = Denied). Orderers/riders may instead use the filter syntax status[eq]. Example: 2

uuid[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by restaurant UUID. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: 9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b

name[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact restaurant name. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Mama's Kitchen

nameShort[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact short name. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: MK

email[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact email. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: info@mamaskitchen.co.ke

aboutShort[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact short description. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Kenyan cuisine

phoneNo[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact phone number. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: +254712345678

address[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by exact address. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Moi Avenue, Nairobi

city[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by city. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Nairobi

state[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by state/county. Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Nairobi

mapLocation[eq]   string  optional    

Filter by map location (operators: eq, gt, lt). Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: Nairobi

latitude[gt]   string  optional    

Filter by latitude (operators: eq, gt, lt). Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: -1.5

longitude[lt]   string  optional    

Filter by longitude (operators: eq, gt, lt). Applied for orderer (when no lat/lng) and rider callers. Example: 37.0

postalCode[eq]   string  optional

);

Update a restaurant

requires authentication

Updates the restaurant details. Served to restaurant owners/employees (PUT /v1/restaurant/restaurants/{restaurant}, POST /v1/restaurant/restaurants/{restaurant}/update), riders (resource route) and admins (POST /v1/admin/restaurants/{restaurant}/update). Users with role orderer get 401. When latitude/longitude are sent the country is resolved via Google Geocoding. If a restaurant/employee updates a Pending or Denied restaurant, a Denied one is moved back to Pending and the admin is notified; an admin update sets the status to Approved. Send as multipart/form-data (with POST) when uploading a logo.

List restaurants

requires authentication

Returns a paginated list of restaurants. The result depends on the caller: guests (GET /v1/restaurants, GET /v1/orderer/orderer-restaurants) and users with role orderer get approved restaurants (sorted by distance within 200,000 km when lat/lng are given) with questionnaire, reviews and tables loaded; role rider (GET /v1/rider/restaurants) gets approved restaurants filtered by the filter params (15 per page); role restaurant (GET /v1/restaurant/restaurants) gets only their own restaurants (any status, 10 per page, newest first) with orders and menus; role restaurant employee gets the single restaurant they are assigned to.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/restaurants?lat=-1.2833&lng=36.8167&per_page=20&search=Kitchen&status=2&uuid%5Beq%5D=9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b&name%5Beq%5D=Mama%27s+Kitchen&nameShort%5Beq%5D=MK&email%5Beq%5D=info%40mamaskitchen.co.ke&aboutShort%5Beq%5D=Kenyan+cuisine&phoneNo%5Beq%5D=%2B254712345678&address%5Beq%5D=Moi+Avenue%2C+Nairobi&city%5Beq%5D=Nairobi&state%5Beq%5D=Nairobi&mapLocation%5Beq%5D=Nairobi&latitude%5Bgt%5D=-1.5&longitude%5Blt%5D=37.0&postalCode%5Beq%5D=00100" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/restaurants"
);

const params = {
    "lat": "-1.2833",
    "lng": "36.8167",
    "per_page": "20",
    "search": "Kitchen",
    "status": "2",
    "uuid[eq]": "9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b",
    "name[eq]": "Mama's Kitchen",
    "nameShort[eq]": "MK",
    "email[eq]": "info@mamaskitchen.co.ke",
    "aboutShort[eq]": "Kenyan cuisine",
    "phoneNo[eq]": "+254712345678",
    "address[eq]": "Moi Avenue, Nairobi",
    "city[eq]": "Nairobi",
    "state[eq]": "Nairobi",
    "mapLocation[eq]": "Nairobi",
    "latitude[gt]": "-1.5",
    "longitude[lt]": "37.0",
    "postalCode[eq]": "00100",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Register a restaurant

requires authentication

Creates a restaurant owned by the authenticated user (served by POST /v1/restaurant/restaurant and the restaurants resource routes). The restaurant role is added to the user if missing. Country is set to Kenya and the status is set to Approved. A "partner account created" email is queued to the owner after the response.

Update a restaurant

requires authentication

Updates the restaurant details. Served to restaurant owners/employees (PUT /v1/restaurant/restaurants/{restaurant}, POST /v1/restaurant/restaurants/{restaurant}/update), riders (resource route) and admins (POST /v1/admin/restaurants/{restaurant}/update). Users with role orderer get 401. When latitude/longitude are sent the country is resolved via Google Geocoding. If a restaurant/employee updates a Pending or Denied restaurant, a Denied one is moved back to Pending and the admin is notified; an admin update sets the status to Approved. Send as multipart/form-data (with POST) when uploading a logo.

Export restaurants to Excel

requires authentication

Generates and downloads an .xlsx file of restaurants, optionally filtered. Intended for restaurant owners.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/restaurants/export/data?search=Kitchen&status=2" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/restaurants/export/data"
);

const params = {
    "search": "Kitchen",
    "status": "2",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

requires authentication

Add a restaurant category

requires authentication

Creates an approved food category owned by the restaurant. Returns the first page (7 per page) of all food categories.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b/categories/add" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "title=Breakfast"\
    --form "description=Morning meals"\
    --form "image=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php9158.tmp" 
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/restaurant/9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b/categories/add"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('title', 'Breakfast');
body.append('description', 'Morning meals');
body.append('image', document.querySelector('input[name="image"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());

Update a restaurant

requires authentication

Updates the restaurant details. Served to restaurant owners/employees (PUT /v1/restaurant/restaurants/{restaurant}, POST /v1/restaurant/restaurants/{restaurant}/update), riders (resource route) and admins (POST /v1/admin/restaurants/{restaurant}/update). Users with role orderer get 401. When latitude/longitude are sent the country is resolved via Google Geocoding. If a restaurant/employee updates a Pending or Denied restaurant, a Denied one is moved back to Pending and the admin is notified; an admin update sets the status to Approved. Send as multipart/form-data (with POST) when uploading a logo.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/restaurants/9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b/update" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "name=Mama's Kitchen"\
    --form "name_short=MK"\
    --form "email=info@mamaskitchen.co.ke"\
    --form "about=Authentic Kenyan cuisine served fresh daily."\
    --form "about_short=Kenyan cuisine"\
    --form "phone_no=+254712345678"\
    --form "address=Moi Avenue, Nairobi"\
    --form "state=Nairobi"\
    --form "postal_code=00100"\
    --form "map_location=Nairobi"\
    --form "url=https://mamaskitchen.co.ke"\
    --form "latitude=-1.2833"\
    --form "longitude=36.8167"\
    --form "city=Nairobi"\
    --form "paypal_email=payouts@mamaskitchen.co.ke"\
    --form "logo=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php929E.tmp" 
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/restaurants/9b1f7c2e-3a4d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('name', 'Mama's Kitchen');
body.append('name_short', 'MK');
body.append('email', 'info@mamaskitchen.co.ke');
body.append('about', 'Authentic Kenyan cuisine served fresh daily.');
body.append('about_short', 'Kenyan cuisine');
body.append('phone_no', '+254712345678');
body.append('address', 'Moi Avenue, Nairobi');
body.append('state', 'Nairobi');
body.append('postal_code', '00100');
body.append('map_location', 'Nairobi');
body.append('url', 'https://mamaskitchen.co.ke');
body.append('latitude', '-1.2833');
body.append('longitude', '36.8167');
body.append('city', 'Nairobi');
body.append('paypal_email', 'payouts@mamaskitchen.co.ke');
body.append('logo', document.querySelector('input[name="logo"]').files[0]);

Store review for an order

requires authentication

Lets the authenticated customer review the restaurant and the rider of an order. The restaurant's average rating is recalculated. The rider review is only saved when the order has a rider with a rider profile.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/order/reviews/store" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"order_id\": 10,
    \"restaurant_rating\": 5,
    \"restaurant_review\": \"Great food, quick service.\",
    \"rider_rating\": 4,
    \"rider_review\": \"Friendly and on time.\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/order/reviews/store"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "order_id": 10,
    "restaurant_rating": 5,
    "restaurant_review": "Great food, quick service.",
    "rider_rating": 4,
    "rider_review": "Friendly and on time."
};

fetch(url, {

Riders

Create rider profile

requires authentication

Creates a rider profile for the authenticated user using the user's name, email and phone number. If the user already has a rider profile, the existing profile is returned unchanged.

Example request:

    --form "vehicle_type=motorbike"\
    --form "vehicle_license_plate=KMDA 123A"\
    --form "paypal_email=rider@example.com"\
    --form "address=12 Moi Avenue"\
    --form "city=Nairobi"\
    --form "state=Nairobi"\
    --form "postal_code=00100"\
    --form "profile_picture=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php8F4A.tmp"

    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/rider/profile/create"
);

    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",

};

body.append('vehicle_license_plate', 'KMDA 123A');

Update order delivery status

requires authentication

Lets the authenticated rider accept, reject or progress an order delivery. accept assigns the order to the rider (status 2, "In Progress"), awaiting_pick_up sets status 3, on_delivery/on delivery sets status 4 and delivered sets status 5 and emails a receipt to the customer. Any other allowed value (reject) marks the assignment as rejected and re-assigns the order to another rider. The customer and restaurant are notified (FCM push, notifications, broadcast events).

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/rider/orders/update" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"order_id\": \"3f6c1a2b-7d8e-4f90-a1b2-c3d4e5f6a7b8\",
    \"status\": \"accept\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/rider/orders/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "order_id": "3f6c1a2b-7d8e-4f90-a1b2-c3d4e5f6a7b8",
    "status": "accept"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Update delivery location

requires authentication

Updates the rider's live location during delivery of an order. The location is pushed to the customer via FCM (when they have a device token) and broadcast via the OrderDeliveryLocationUpdate event. Rate limited by the location throttle.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/rider/orders/12/delivery/location/update" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"longitude\": \"36.8219\",
    \"latitude\": \"-1.2847473\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/rider/orders/12/delivery/location/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "longitude": "36.8219",
    "latitude": "-1.2847473"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Example response (200, Success):


{
    "status": "Request was succesful",
    "message": "Location updated successfully",
    "data": "Location update"
}

Example response (422, Validation error):


{
    "latitude": [
        "The latitude field is required."
    ],
    "longitude": [
        "The longitude field is required."
    ]
}

Update rider location

requires authentication

Updates the authenticated rider's current location when not delivering. The coordinates are reverse geocoded via Google Maps and the formatted address is stored on the user.

    --header "Accept: application/json" \

    \"longitude\": \"36.8219\",

}"

    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",

};

Supplements

Supplements, supplement categories, suppliers and supplement orders. Customer-facing endpoints live under v1/orderer/supplements, admin endpoints under v1/admin/supplements.

List supplements

Returns a paginated list of supplements. Guests and regular users only see available supplements. Authenticated users with role admin or supplements admin see all supplements (with orders_count), can filter by search/supplier, and additionally receive the list of suppliers and categories.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/supplements?per_page=15&page=1&search=protein&supplier=1" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/supplements"
);

const params = {
    "per_page": "15",
    "page": "1",
    "search": "protein",
    "supplier": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Create a supplement order

requires authentication

Places a supplement order for the authenticated user. Payment is done separately via GET v1/orderer/supplements/orders/{id}/pay.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/supplements/orders" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"supplement_id\": 1,
    \"quantity\": 2
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/orderer/supplements/orders"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "supplement_id": 1,
    "quantity": 2
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

List supplements

Create a supplement

requires authentication

Admin endpoint. Registers a new supplement with its images and logs the activity.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/supplements/store" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "supplier_id=1"\
    --form "category_id=1"\
    --form "name=Whey Protein"\
    --form "price=2500"\
    --form "measuring_unit=kilograms"\
    --form "description=Premium whey protein powder."\
    --form "prescription=One scoop daily."\
    --form "category=Fitness"\
    --form "images[]=@C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Temp\php930D.tmp" 
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/supplements/store"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('supplier_id', '1');
body.append('category_id', '1');
body.append('name', 'Whey Protein');
body.append('price', '2500');
body.append('measuring_unit', 'kilograms');
body.append('description', 'Premium whey protein powder.');
body.append('prescription', 'One scoop daily.');
body.append('category', 'Fitness');
body.append('images[]', document.querySelector('input[name="images[]"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());

List supplement orders

requires authentication

Returns paginated supplement orders. Users with role admin or supplements admin see all orders; other users see only their own orders.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/supplements/orders?per_page=15&page=1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/supplements/orders"
);

const params = {
    "per_page": "15",
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Update supplement order status

requires authentication

Admin endpoint. Updates the order status and courier details. Setting delivered or on delivery sends a notification to the customer; confirmed is stored as delivered.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/supplements/order/1/status/update" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"status\": \"on delivery\",
    \"expected_delivery_date\": \"2024-11-05\",
    \"courier_name\": \"John Rider\",
    \"courier_email\": \"courier@example.com\",
    \"courier_phone\": \"254700000000\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://moboeats.test/api/v3/admin/supplements/order/1/status/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "status": "on delivery",
    "expected_delivery_date": "2024-11-05",
    "courier_name": "John Rider",
    "courier_email": "courier@example.com",
    "courier_phone": "254700000000"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Example response (200, Updated):

    "status": "Request was succesful",
    "message": "Order Status updated successfully",
